description: Untrusted data reaching the SQL argument of a query API, by concatenation and by template literal. The third route passes the same untrusted value to the same API as a PARAMETER and is not a finding: the channel names only the argument that is interpreted, so a parameterized call cannot match. That is a property of describing the destination accurately, not an exception written into the policy. The fourth route runs a constant query and is silent because nothing untrusted reaches it.

expected.note: a template literal is still concatenation
